title: Chili Stuffed Fried Nachos
description: Giant stuffed chili fried Cheez-It with homemade chili on top of pizza dough, cheddar cheese, and crispy fried exterior.
steps: Spread a layer of homemade chili on the pizza dough.
Sprinkle cheddar cheese over the chili.
Fold the dough over to enclose the chili and cheese, forming a large pocket.
Brush the folded dough with egg wash.
Crush Cheez-Its and coat the folded dough with the crushed Cheez-Its.
Heat vegetable oil to 350°F (175°C) in a deep fryer or large pot.
Fry the stuffed dough until golden brown and crispy.
Remove from oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot, showcasing the melted cheese and chili inside.
